decisions.subject: offline ceremony environment and exact cryptographic toolchain provenance
decisions.recommended_option: use a dedicated owner-controlled offline Linux environment with a pre-provisioned OpenSSH ssh-keygen-compatible Ed25519 toolchain; before authorization record the non-secret environment ID, OS and tool versions, binary/library SHA-256 values, and evidence that network interfaces are unavailable during the one action
evidence: ADR-0076 selects a new offline Ed25519 ceremony but supplies no environment or tool bytes.
The P4-K-A template leaves exact tool IDs, versions, hashes, and fixed argv null.
No current repository or stand inventory is evidence for an owner-controlled offline ceremony environment.
decisions.scientific_effect: none; the environment creates authorization-key evidence and cannot access experiment treatments or outcomes
decisions.compatibility_effect: environment identity, OS/tool versions, executable/library hashes, network-isolation evidence, and output-format compatibility become ceremony identity
decisions.deadline_gate: before repository-local controller specialization and before any P4-K-A issuance
decisions.supersession_rule: any environment, executable, library, version, network state, or output-format change requires a new clean inventory, review, and prospective decision

decisions.subject: private-key protection, interactive secret boundary, and operational custody evidence
decisions.recommended_option: require an encrypted OpenSSH Ed25519 private key, an owner-selected exact KDF-work value, interactive passphrase entry excluded from argv/environment/stdin capture and every artifact, and a non-secret custody receipt that records controls and recovery policy without a private path, private bytes, seed, or passphrase
evidence: ADR-0066 and ADR-0077 prohibit repository/stand private-key custody and serialize only logical custody identity.
The accepted P4-K-A template requires operational custody evidence without private paths or bytes.
No encryption/KDF work value, access-control evidence, backup, recovery, retention, or destruction policy is currently frozen.
decisions.scientific_effect: none; protection controls only authorization-key custody
decisions.compatibility_effect: private-key encoding, KDF and exact work value, secret-input boundary, custodian controls, recovery/retention policy, and non-secret receipt hash become custody identity
decisions.deadline_gate: before controller contract freeze or P4-K-A issuance
decisions.supersession_rule: any key encoding, KDF/work value, secret-input, custodian, access, backup, recovery, retention, or destruction change requires prospective acceptance and new evidence

decisions.subject: create-exclusive public export identity, paths, and custody boundary
decisions.recommended_option: select one unused action ID and an absolute create-exclusive public export root in the owner-controlled offline domain; freeze public-key, allowed-signers, receipt, inventory, and sidecar basenames while keeping the private-key path secret and absent from every record
evidence: ADR-0077 leaves the absolute public allowed-signers source path unresolved.
ADR-0078 requires append-only complete or partial public evidence and forbids overwrite or cleanup.
Neither repository nor stand paths may be inferred as the offline public export root.
decisions.scientific_effect: none; public paths identify authorization evidence only
decisions.compatibility_effect: action ID, public root, artifact basenames, owner/mode/access contract, create-exclusive policy, and receipt/sidecar hashes become evidence identity
decisions.deadline_gate: before controller specialization, artifact construction, or P4-K-A issuance
decisions.supersession_rule: any root, path, artifact ID, basename, owner/mode/access, collision, or retention change requires a new unused action identity and prospective decision

decisions.subject: independent bootstrap signer and trust anchor for authorizing target-key creation
decisions.recommended_option: require an already established signer distinct from the target P4-K key, custodian, and auditor, with non-secret Ed25519 public fingerprint, canonical allowed-signers/trust bytes, artifact SHA-256, custody evidence, signature principal/namespace compatibility, and independent review; if that evidence does not exist, stop and establish a bootstrap governance root under a separate process before P4-K-A
evidence: ADR-0079 explicitly prohibits the nonexistent target key from authorizing its own creation.
The accepted P4-K-A template leaves bootstrap signer fingerprint and trust-evidence SHA-256 null.
Repository messages, SSH reachability, and root access are not OpenSSH SSHSIG evidence.
decisions.scientific_effect: none; the bootstrap signer authorizes one custody action and cannot change experiment semantics
decisions.compatibility_effect: bootstrap public key/fingerprint, trust bytes/hash, custody lineage, principal/namespace, signature algorithm, and reviewer receipt become authorization identity
decisions.deadline_gate: blocking before any P4-K-A authorization can be signed or issued
decisions.supersession_rule: any signer, public key, fingerprint, trust artifact, custody, principal, namespace, algorithm, or reviewer change requires new unsigned authorization bytes and prospective acceptance

decisions.subject: repository-owned no-authority controller contract and exact one-shot action graph
decisions.recommended_option: after separate acceptance implement a repository-owned controller that has no key-action mode without a later signed authorization, executes only an accepted absolute tool path with fixed argv and environment, accepts the passphrase only through an uncaptured controlling TTY or dedicated non-recorded descriptor, uses create-exclusive public outputs, captures bounded non-secret stdout/stderr/exit evidence, attempts once, retries zero times, and stops before P4-K-R
evidence: ADR-0078 freezes one attempt, zero retry, and the mandatory stop before P4-K-R.
The current P4-K-A template is a record only and contains no executable controller or exact command.
The existing Q15-R fixed-controller pattern demonstrates a no-authority CLI and hash-bound direct-argv boundary without authorizing reuse for P4-K-A.
decisions.scientific_effect: none; controller implementation is outside the experiment process and cannot access outcomes
decisions.compatibility_effect: controller source/binary hash, process/FD/TTY contract, exact argv/environment, output bounds, action order, attempt count, and failure receipt become transaction identity
decisions.deadline_gate: acceptance before repository-local implementation; clean release and exact inputs before issuance
decisions.supersession_rule: any controller byte, tool path, argv, environment, descriptor, secret-input, output, order, bound, retry, or failure-policy change requires a new clean release and prospective acceptance

decisions.subject: pre-execution authorization review, UTC issuance, partial evidence, and mandatory post-action stop
decisions.recommended_option: require canonical unsigned authorization bytes bound to every environment/tool/controller/path/custody/bootstrap input, a distinct auditor pre-execution review, literal issue and expiry instants exactly 1800 seconds apart, SSHSIG signature and hash verification, first-failure stop, append-only complete or partial public receipts, no delete/cleanup/retry, and mandatory stop for separately authorized P4-K-R
evidence: ADR-0079 freezes the authority, 1800-second, JCS-I64, SSHSIG, and distinct-review policy without supplying literal evidence.
ADR-0078 requires a mandatory stop between P4-K-A and P4-K-R.
The P4-K-A template leaves UTC, authorization, signature, and auditor review fields null.
decisions.scientific_effect: none; issuance governs a single offline key-custody action
decisions.compatibility_effect: canonical authorization bytes/hash, exact UTC instants, signer fingerprint, detached signature hash, pre-review hash, complete/partial receipt, and stop disposition become action identity
decisions.deadline_gate: policy acceptance before template specialization; literal evidence immediately before P4-K-A issuance
decisions.supersession_rule: any authority, duration, canonicalization, signer, review, failure, retention, retry, cleanup, or continuation change requires new authorization bytes and prospective acceptance

minimum_owner_inputs_before_policy_accep.question: Accept or revise the recommended D-080 dedicated offline Linux/OpenSSH environment and exact toolchain-provenance contract.
Accept or revise D-081 encrypted private-key, interactive uncaptured secret, exact future KDF-work input, and non-secret custody-receipt contract.
Accept or revise D-082 create-exclusive public export identity/path contract; actual absolute path remains a later owner input.
State whether a qualifying existing distinct bootstrap Ed25519 governance signer and reviewed public trust evidence exist; never provide private material.
Accept or revise D-084/D-085 fixed no-authority controller, issuance, review, partial-evidence, and mandatory-stop recommendations.
